criteria.criterion: Wherever the guard runs today (around every session, gate and check, including the base gates at acceptance and the gate review), .git/config is compared by its own entries — keys and values, include directives as entries, never the files they include — not by its bytes; the git hooks guard is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: An entry whose key matches an ignore pattern is left out of both sides. The built-in pattern is branch.*.vscode-merge-base and is always applied. criteria.criterion: run.git-config-ignore is a list config key (environment VLOOP_RUN_GIT_CONFIG_IGNORE, comma-separated) whose patterns are added to the built-in one; it never removes the built-in pattern. vloop config get and config list show it.
criteria.evidence: internal/config/config.go Keys entry; snapshotGit appends v.List to the built-in; config list expectations in cmd/vloop/e2e_test.go and internal/cli/config_test.go; TestRunGitConfigIgnoreFromEnvironment

criteria.criterion: A pattern is protected when its text before the first * (all of it, if it has none) and one of core., filter., include., includeif. is a prefix of the other. vloop config set run.git-config-ignore with a protected pattern (alone or in a list) exits 2, writes nothing, and prints exactly `vloop: run.git-config-ignore: <pattern> would ignore <section>.* — the guard must see it`, <pattern> the offending pattern itself (core.* for the list gitlens.*,core.*), <section> the first of core, filter, include, includeif, in that order, it collides with: *, c*, core.* and filter.lfs.* are refused; gitlens.* and branch.*.vscode-merge-base are not.
criteria.evidence: gitcfg.Protected (prefix either way, ordered sections), config.Key.Validate wraps ProtectedPatternError in UsageError; TestProtected and TestGitConfigIgnoreRefusesProtectedPatterns

criteria.criterion: vloop run with a protected pattern in VLOOP_RUN_GIT_CONFIG_IGNORE or in the config file refuses with exit 1 and the same line, before any session runs.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/run.go config.Get before the run starts; sourceErr returns the bare ProtectedPatternError; TestRunGitConfigProtectedPatternRefused asserts exit 1 and the line (env source; the file source uses the same resolveList path)

criteria.criterion: Any other entry added, removed or changed halts with exit 9 and exactly `vloop: <who> changed .git/config (<key>[, <key>…][ and <n> more]) — nothing was committed; restore it, then re-run`: at most three keys, sorted, then how many more; <who> is what it is today (work, review, plan, the gate review, the gate of T5, the check go, …). An ignored key never appears among the named keys and never halts on its own.
criteria.evidence: gitGuard.changed/diffEntries: sorted keys, maxNamedKeys=3, 'and n more'; TestRunGitConfigPlanted asserts the full line with core.fsmonitor; new TestGitGuardValuelessKeyIsNotAnEmptyValue and TestGitGuardRepeatedKeyOrderMatters close the earlier bare/empty and ordering gaps

criteria.criterion: Violations the review must rule against: a key outside the ignore patterns that changes without halting; an ignored key that halts; a built-in pattern list in the binary that a repository cannot extend; a guard that only checks known-dangerous keys.
